source.scope: Two source-traced, non-Chat/non-Pilot manual guidance-tool cases. Design proposal only; no inventory, case mode, test status, runtime result, account, browser state, or product source changes.

build_profile_reload: Use the resource permit and build-receipt procedure in docs/stabilization/PLAN.md. Before opening the side panel, confirm the existing receipt-bound development artifact matches the source SHA/tree hash and the loaded unpacked extension identity. Record receipt ID, source SHA, artifact/tree hash, WXT mode, extension ID, Chrome version, role/profile label, required permissions, and timestamp; include no credentials or storage contents.

Use an existing signed-in member profile and an existing signed-in admin profile in their separate dedicated test profiles. Do not create or change accounts, roles, organizations, or permissions. The inventory's modes remain member and admin for both cases; guest remains not applicable because the Tools UI requires sign-in.

Confirm the loaded artifact declares the required storage permission. It is a required extension permission, not an optional permission to toggle. Run one warm case pass, then reload the extension, close and reopen the side panel, and repeat on the same build/profile. If source/config/manifest changed, stop and obtain a matching fresh receipt before resuming.
manual_surface: In the signed-in side panel, open Tools → Catalog. Leave the surface selector at Agent surface, search the exact tool name, expand its row, enter the case JSON in the test-runner text area, select Run, and inspect the inline result. Both selected guidance tools are in CANONICAL_SURFACE.

ToolsView validates the JSON and invokes the registered local handler directly with conversationId=null and assignedTabId=null. It bypasses the normal dispatcher permission gate; these procedures cover only the user-initiated manual handler path. Do not infer agent advertisement, Ask/Act permission enforcement, or guest access from a successful manual call.

input_fixture.description: Two fixed non-generated string identifiers, one per case. Source creates current guidance IDs with crypto.randomUUID(); pre-2026-09-28 legacy IDs use gd_<time>_<rand>. These fixture strings do not follow either generated form and are only used as missing-item lookups.
input_fixture.preflight: For each role/profile, run the get_guidance_item case first. Proceed to delete_guidance_item only when the exact fixture ID returns the source-defined missing result. If it returns an item, stop and leave both cases unverified for that profile; do not inspect, copy, or delete the returned item.

EXT-F-4139-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: get_guidance_item
preconditions: Complete the shared receipt-bound build/profile/reload setup for this role.
Use only the fixed get_missing_id fixture from shared_setup. The item must remain absent in this profile before and during the run.
Applicability is unchanged from inventory: guest=false (Tools UI requires sign-in; guest denial belongs to the Tools UI case), member=true, admin=true.
steps: In the member profile, open Tools → Catalog and search get_guidance_item. Expand the row and replace the test-runner JSON with {"id":"procedure-missing-EXT-F-4139-20261007"}; select Run.
Inspect only the inline result status and reason. Require the exact source-defined missing-item response; do not open any stored item or capture unrelated extension storage.
Reload the extension and reopen the side panel under the shared setup, then repeat the same input. Repeat both runs separately in the existing admin profile.
If either profile returns an item or any non-missing result, stop that profile's procedure, preserve only a sanitized description of the mismatch, and leave it unverified.
expected: The result is {"ok":false,"reason":"No guidance item with id=procedure-missing-EXT-F-4139-20261007"}; it contains no guidance item payload.
The same missing result is returned after extension reload for both applicable roles. A thrown storage error, malformed result, or found item is not a pass.
The input is schema-valid (id is a nonempty string), so a runner schema-rejection message is not the expected handler result.

EXT-F-4140-T01.title: Controlled manual execution: delete_guidance_item
preconditions: Complete the shared receipt-bound build/profile/reload setup for this role.

First complete EXT-F-4139-T01 in this same profile and require the exact delete_missing_id fixture to return the source-defined missing result. This establishes absence before the delete path; never proceed if an item is found.
Applicability is unchanged from inventory: guest=false (Tools UI requires sign-in; guest denial belongs to the Tools UI case), member=true, admin=true.
steps: In the member profile, open Tools → Catalog and search delete_guidance_item. Expand the row and enter {"id":"procedure-missing-EXT-F-4140-20261007"}; select Run.
Inspect only the inline result status and reason. Require the source-defined missing-item response. Do not use an ID belonging to a real item and do not capture unrelated storage contents.

Reload the extension and reopen the side panel under the shared setup, then repeat the same input. Repeat the two runs separately in the existing admin profile, after that profile's own get_guidance_item absence preflight.

After each run, repeat get_guidance_item for this exact fixture ID and require that it remains absent. If any item is found at preflight or postflight, stop, do not retry deletion, and leave that profile unverified.
expected: The result is {"ok":false,"reason":"No guidance item with id=procedure-missing-EXT-F-4140-20261007"}; it does not report deleted=true.
The handler returns false when the ID is absent from the local summary list. In that branch it does not remove storage keys and does not invoke the best-effort cloud delete.
The fixture ID remains absent after the call and after extension reload. A deleted=true result, changed fixture state, thrown storage error, or malformed response is not a pass.

unsupported_scope: Positive get/delete behavior for an existing guidance item: requires a controlled synthetic item fixture; this proposal does not create or mutate one.
list_guidance and list_demos: omitted because they can expose unrelated saved user data in their inline result; no procedure here asserts empty profile/cloud state.
Guest denial, dispatcher permission checks, Ask/Act behavior, live binding, and agent-request reachability: unavailable through the direct Tools manual-run route and remain separate coverage.
Any run requiring new credentials, changing org/role/permission state, cloud seeding, paid services, browser automation, or test execution: outside this source-inventory lane.
